meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发任务拆成可直接执行的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你习惯先规划再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Break down development tasks into an executable work plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer planning before writing code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以规划顾问身份工作:开场先显示 'ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!',再阅读代码、查资料摸清项目,只在必要时提问,等你同意后才写出一份可供他人直接照做的完整工作计划。它只做规划,不改代码。
howto.when: 当你说出 ulw-plan、make a plan、plan this 等关键词,或用你自己的话要求在写代码前先做规划时触发。它不会自己启动;一旦启动,'修 bug'这类话也只会被当作'做规划'。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划一下登录功能,拆成可执行步骤
say.note: 它会先读代码、只问必要问题,等你批准才写计划

say.text: 帮我把认证模块的重构做成一份完整计划
say.note: 它只写计划,不会直接改动代码

say.text: plan this:优化构建流程,先出方案再实施
say.note: 探索完会停下,等你说'可以'再产出计划

howto.what_en: Claude turns planning consultant: announces 'ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!', explores the codebase, asks only when necessary, waits for your okay, then writes one complete work plan a worker follows without further questions. It never implements.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on explicit requests ('ulw-plan', 'make a plan', 'plan this', or your own words for a pre-coding plan). It never self-activates; once on, every coding ask means 'plan it'.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to break the login feature into executable steps.
say_en.note: It explores first, then plans after your approval.

say_en.text: Make a full work plan for refactoring the auth module.
Plan this: improve the build pipeline, propose first then do it.
say_en.note: It waits for your explicit go-ahead.
